markets.rules_primary: If the Carbon Arc Shein Monthly Credit Card Spend (August 2026) for August 2026 is above 98, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
For purposes of this market, determination will resolve on the first value reported by Carbon Arc. Corrections or revisions made after the market has been settled will not affect the outcome. 

The index measures year-over-year change, where 100 means Shein Monthly Credit Card Spend was equal to the same month last year. Values above 100 indicate growth and values below 100 indicate decline: for example, 103 = 3% more spend than year prior, 97 = 3% decline from year prior. The index is measured by Carbon Arc's aggregated U.S. credit and debit card transaction panel, matched to the same period of the prior year. The panel updates daily as new data arrives.

If Jared Moskowitz runs under multiple parties or is listed multiple times, votes attributable to the same underlying candidate will be summed.

If Bennedict Mathurin's 
next team is the Washington Pro Basketball team
 before Oct 21, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.

If Bennedict Mathurin officially retires before Oct 21, 2026 or is not signed to any team on Oct 21, 2026, "Retires / No Team" resolves to Yes. 
If Bennedict Mathurin remains on the team they were on upon issuance on Oct 21, 2026, then the market for that team will resolve Yes.
If Bennedict Mathurin is a free agent, whether restricted or unrestricted, for any period of time and signs a contract with any team, including their previous team, the market for that team will resolve Yes.
If Bennedict Mathurin signs a contract extension or re-signs while under contract with that same team, that does not trigger an early resolution of this market.
Note: In order for the market to resolve early, the transaction must be made official and reported by the Governing League, or Bennedict Mathurin must formally announce that he is retiring as reported by a Source Agency.
